OpenAI publishes 722 math manuscripts from an unreleased internal model
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-722-math-manuscripts/

Penguin Mail, a Rust email client for Linux, adds a local AI assistant

Penguin Mail 1.0.0 is a GPL-3.0 Rust mail app whose optional assistant runs through LM Studio or Ollama and asks before sending, its developer says. It hit the Hacker News front page.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-penguin-mail-linux/

Google ships Nano Banana 2.1 image model at half the price of 2.0

Google says Nano Banana 2.1 improves on its predecessor across the board and costs $0.0336 per 1K image, down from $0.067. It is live in Gemini, Search AI Mode and AI Studio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nano-banana-2-1-launch/
